build_system: npm with next build. Next.js 16.2.6, React 19.2.4, Tailwind CSS v4 with @tailwindcss/postcss
test_framework: None configured yet - will use next build for type checking
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install dependencies. 2. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compiles and pages build. 3. Optionally run npm run dev to test locally.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode - can install any npm packages. Node.js v22 available. No external database - use file-based JSON storage in data/ directory.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md says to read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for Next.js API changes before writing code. Next.js 16 may have breaking changes from training data.
key_patterns: App Router with src/app directory. Tailwind CSS v4 using @import 'tailwindcss' in globals.css with @theme inline block. Path alias @/* maps to ./src/*. PostCSS config uses @tailwindcss/postcss plugin. Layout uses Geist fonts.
directory_structure: src/app/ - App Router pages and layouts. public/ - static assets. Root has config files (tsconfig, next.config, eslint, postcss).
